off_target_inertness.note: Re-measured on the shipping build with `--option listing on --option aif on` forced. x86-64 RIP-relative loads target .rodata rather than .text interstices, and i386 has no PC-relative addressing at all, so the predicate is vacuous by ISA.

split.cause: A literal reference resolves onto the function's own first word, which the Listing never decoded, so the inference reads those four bytes as a pool.
split.rejected_guard: Refusing to emit at a known branch target removes it and costs 108 of 189 recovered ground-truth entries - dominated.

speed.note: Two runs: the env-gated measurement build and a re-run on the shipping build. The box carried two other agents' full workspace suites throughout (load average ~90-100), so only the A32 row reproduces cleanly. The cost is real - the pass re-decodes every gap-discovered body to harvest its literal references - and is net-positive only because the retired phantoms stop being decompiled. An ARM image with pools but no phantoms pays it with no benefit.

notes: Default-OFF, so no DIV row (default output is byte-identical; make test / make test-stages PARITY OK). Parked in modes.rs UNEVALUATED next to its three sequence siblings: cortexmvectors, ptrentry, tailcallentry and poolentry COMPOSE, every number here is measured on top of the other three, and preset membership should be one joint evaluation rather than four.
residual_risks: The corpus is 91 unique images from one benchmark, and there is exactly ONE A32 image (u-boot), so the whole A32 result rests on it. decbench has no aarch64/MIPS/PPC/RISC-V image at all; inertness there is reasoned (those targets route constants to .rodata/.sdata), not measured.

Suppression is applied to AIF's accept list, not to the fully merged entry set. The fdeinterior seam in kuna-console/src/engine.rs is the architecturally correct home and would let the pairing test see entries from ptrentry/tailcallentry/cortexmvectors; that variant is unmeasured and is a follow-up, not this PR.

fdeinterior's warrant does not transfer: an FDE is an extent the compiler wrote into the binary, an inferred pool is a guess. The 0-of-4,220 figure is measured against DWARF from unstripped twins that the runtime predicate does not have.

The merge class is untouched and is ~3x larger: 3,255 of 5,491 interior ground-truth misses corpus-wide have a containing entry that IS a real DWARF entry. Nothing here reaches it, and no claim that ARM entry recall is closed survives that factor.

i386 PE has a separate, unreached defect: 55 AIF-only entries, 23 of them (41.8%) strictly inside a real body, with no fdeinterior protection because that pass is ELF-only. Not fixed, not broken, not covered.
production_vs_measurement: The shipping build reads the PC bias from the engine ContextDatabase instead of the image-wide 16-bit-instruction shim. The full 98-image sweep is set-identical to the measurement arm on 96 of 98 images; the two that differ are the byte-identical crazyflie O2-noinline pair, where the production reader is slightly more conservative and keeps 9 phantoms each. Whole delta: removals 4,238 -> 4,220 (and split_removed 4,236 -> 4,218); new/GT/lost/splits unchanged at 191/188/0/1.
